scope: remote SV_ClientEnterWorld attempt and the inline patch design

client_pointer.verification: state 3 = CS_PRIMED, matching the server log; svs.clients base 0x50E2650 is stale/misleading (all slots read 0), the live array starts at 0x5692650

remote_call.shellcode: push 0; push client; mov eax,0x4705F4; call eax; add esp,8; ret
remote_call.result: dedrun terminated immediately; the server log ends at CS_PRIMED, no CS_ACTIVE
remote_call.cause: SV_ClientEnterWorld runs SV_GentityNum + ClientBegin which needs the server main thread / game context; a foreign thread crashes the process

inline_patch_design.current: cmp eax,4 / je 0x48AAF1 / mov eax,[ebx] / cmp eax,4 / je 0x48AABA / cmp eax,1 / jne 0x48AA63 / mov eax,ebx / call 0x489081
plan: patch 0x48AAB5 '83 f8 01' (cmp eax,1) to '83 f8 03' (cmp eax,3) so CS_PRIMED enters the same block
clear edx (cmd = NULL) before the call; SV_ClientEnterWorld reads its arguments from the stack at [ebp+8]/[ebp+0xc], so the calling convention must be re-checked first
after the first frame the state becomes CS_ACTIVE and the normal snapshot path runs
inline_patch_design.risk: calling convention mismatch would corrupt the stack; verify SV_BuildClientSnapshot's convention before redirecting the call

next: determine how 0x489081 receives its client argument (eax vs stack) and whether 0x4705F4 uses the same convention
if they differ, patch SV_SendClientMessages at a point where a stack push can be inserted, or use an unused code cave with a stub
then verify CS_ACTIVE, real snapshots and the client leaving phase 8
